# Clean up your own orphans, only your own

`S5.7` · Coding rule

Clean up your own orphans, only your own. Imports, variables, functions and constants that *your* change left unused are removed in the same change. Pre-existing dead code is reported, never deleted (S0.2) — removing it needs its own task.

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-shared|Rules for all code]].
